purpose: Blink-only companion frames for hungry and lonely resting poses

items.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve precise animation edit. Input is the approved 4 by 2 pet sprite sheet. Create a companion EYE BLINK sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows of equal SQUARE cells on a 2:1 landscape canvas, actual transparent alpha background. Preserve this exact character, colors, rendering, thin outlines and face/body scale and position. TOP ROW: use the input TOP LEFT hungry resting pose in ALL FOUR cells. BOTTOM ROW: use the input BOTTOM LEFT lonely resting pose in ALL FOUR cells. Keep each row's face expression, mouth, eyebrow mood and hands as in that resting pose. The ONLY changed part between cells is the eyelids: column 0 eyes fully open exactly as input; column 1 eyes half closed, upper eyelid lowering; column 2 BOTH eyes fully closed, simple delicate curved closed-eye lines, no visible eyeballs, no smile, no sleepy facial change; column 3 eyes half opening. Complete BOTH eyes in every frame, preserve their asymmetric three-quarter perspective. No body/limb/ear/tail/sprout movement AT ALL. No head tilting or bobbing or rotation. No changing anatomy, face position or head size. Do NOT reproduce the arm gestures from the other input columns, just the first resting pose per row. Put each whole pet in central 60% of each cell with at least 15% transparent margin at every side. Entire outline intact, same orientation. No text, grid, white background, checkerboard, floor, shadows, halo or particles. High quality identical warm illustration. A tiny rounded SANDSTONE GOLEM companion, warm sand beige pebble body built from a broad round torso and short chunky stone arms and feet, gentle small dark oval eyes and smiling stone mouth, ONE tiny green sprout growing on top of its head, small turquoise heart-shaped stone inset in chest. Stubby friendly proportions, subtly textured sandstone, no fur, no animal ears, no clothes.
